actions.action: Pull the plant back from the window
Hang a sheer curtain in front of the window
Run a humidifier near the plant
Group plants together to raise humidity
Check whether the top 2-3 cm of soil is dry
Water when the top 2-3 cm of soil is dry, keeping it lightly moist
Check that the pot drains well and the soil isn't staying soggy
Check under the leaves for spider mites

reason: The answer treats the curling as new growth and adjustment to the move, listing low humidity and underwatering only among several possible causes; the humidity and moisture fixes are present but buried, and it even dismisses misting, though nothing it recommends is likely to harm the plant.
